column1: # Flash layout for the 8 MB Feather ESP32 V2 (KTD14).
# The OTA slots are reserved now so P4 never has to move `deckcfg` (and wipe the saved host).
# `deckcfg` uses the `undefined` data subtype: esp-bootloader-esp-idf 0.6 panics on custom
# subtypes (0x40-0xFE) when it builds a FlashRegion. The firmware finds it by label.
